request.description: Requires an Admin Bearer Token and the payments.confirm-cash permission. This endpoint only confirms a pending Cash payment.
Requires a student Bearer Token; enforced by auth:sanctum, not_banned, and role:student middleware.
Creates a Paymob Intention and returns data.next_action.checkout_url. Open it in a browser; the signed webhook, not the redirect, marks the payment as paid.
Use the temporary playback_url returned by Authorize Playback. A byte-range request returns 206 Partial Content.
